title: Two-parameter polynomial time bound
statement: A two-parameter polynomial time bound consists of a function $T\colon\mathbb{N}^2\to\mathbb{N}$ and a polynomial $p$ with natural-number coefficients such that, for all $a,b\in\mathbb{N}$, $T(a,b)\le p(a+b)$.
hypotheses_covered: A time-bound function from two natural-number parameters to a natural number
The time bound is at most the polynomial evaluated at the sum of the parameters, for every pair of natural numbers
